title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
summary: Given a list of flights connecting cities, determine the lowest cost route from a source city to a destination city with at most k stops.
statement: Given a list of flights connecting cities, determine the lowest cost route from a source city to a destination city with at most k stops. If no such route exists, return -1.
constraints: Cities are 0..n-1 with positive directed flight prices.
Return the cheapest src-to-dst cost using at most k stops, or -1.
hints: A route with at most k stops contains at most k+1 edges.
Run bounded Bellman-Ford using a snapshot per edge count.
Repeat k+1 times: copy costs and relax every flight from the previous row.
Snapshots prevent one round from using multiple new edges, so each round expands the allowed route length by exactly one.
editorial: Snapshots prevent one round from using multiple new edges, so each round expands the allowed route length by exactly one.
